turns.text: Hey Lloyd, I'm debugging this weird bug in my frontend where the layout shifts on mobile. It's driving me crazy.
That sounds frustrating. Have you checked if it's related to font loading or image dimensions not being set?
I think it might be the latter. Anyway, I've been reading up on some new research papers today. I found out that DMR is a benchmark established by the MemGPT team.
That's interesting. MemGPT has been making waves in the LLM memory space. Did you find the benchmark details useful?
Yes, it gives a good baseline. I might try running it later. By the way, did the package for my mechanical keyboard switches arrive?
I don't have real-time shipping updates, but I can remind you to check your tracking link if you provide it.
No worries, I'll check manually. Just wanted to make sure you noted that DMR fact for later.
Noted. I'll keep that in mind.
Hi Lloyd, the weather is finally clearing up. I'm planning to go hiking this weekend if it stays dry.
That sounds lovely. Checking the forecast for your area now to see if the dry spell holds.

Great. While I was organizing my notes today, I stumbled upon this method called Closed-Loop Evals use closed-loop prompt auto-tuning with reflect+synthesize prompt-optimizers over labelled production mismatches.
That sounds quite complex. Are you planning to implement those optimizers in your current project?
Maybe. It's a lot to digest. Also, I think I left my charger at the office. Do you have a list of items I usually forget?
I don't have a specific list, but chargers and wallets are common culprits. I can set a reminder to check your bag before you leave.
Thanks. Let me know if you need more info on the Closed-Loop Evals stuff later.
Will do. Enjoy the hiking plans.
